callGraphAndContract.registration: serialization/mod.rs privately exposes text; text/mod.rs uses static path-bound child modules. serialization/tests/mod.rs statically registers the two tests. Derive(Serialize/Deserialize) and serde field attributes define the wire shape; no runtime registry, dynamic dispatch registration, or FFI route was found for these paths.
callGraphAndContract.writer: write_versioned_text_to constructs TextEnvelope { header: current_header::<T>(), payload: value }, wraps it in TextDocument under serde(rename = "$zircon"), and calls write_canonical_text. Raw write_canonical_text_to instead forwards SerializationBudget to write_canonical_text_with_budget.
callGraphAndContract.reader: load_versioned and load_versioned_legacy_schema_zero pass Reject or AcceptSchemaZero to load_text_versioned. It rejects oversized input before inspect_text; for Envelope it validates target schema and source version before reading payload. Current version parses payload.get() directly as T; older version materializes owned serde_json::Value and migrates.
callGraphAndContract.rawValueLifetime: EnvelopeProbe, EnvelopeHeaderProbe, HeaderSignatureProbe, RawTextDocument, and RawTextEnvelope borrow RawValue from the input bytes. inspect_text returns that borrow with its input lifetime. load_text_versioned consumes it synchronously and returns Loaded<T> with no input lifetime; no raw slice escapes.
callGraphAndContract.signatureAndDamageBoundary: A non-object, absent $zircon, non-object envelope/header, or missing either schema_id/schema_version key yields Unversioned. The signature probe checks key presence only; typed header validation follows. Top-level EnvelopeProbe deserialization errors map to Malformed (including syntax or duplicate top-level reserved-key errors); failures while probing/parsing an extracted $zircon candidate map to InvalidEnvelope. A complete signature enters strict deny_unknown_fields structures; later structure errors do not fall back to legacy.
callGraphAndContract.testCoverage: legacy_detection covers unwrapped payload, header+payload domain names, and non-object $zircon string with schema-zero migration. malformed_contract covers invalid JSON versus complete-signature missing payload, typed current-payload failure carrying schema/version, unknown header fields, and extra outer field rejection. load_contract separately covers the size-before-parse check and legacy policy. Tests do not cover partial version headers, duplicate-key matrices, or RawValue lifetime directly; these are recorded coverage limits, not findings.
callGraphAndContract.scopeExclusions: load.rs, write.rs, serialization/error.rs, serialization/mod.rs, payload_header.rs, loaded.rs, load_contract.rs, write_contract.rs, and canonical_writer.rs are read-only caller/test evidence and are not edited by this batch.
